about: Main camera of the pit village street set (works-lane.glb). Blender space is z-up; three.js space is y-up: positions convert as (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y); the camera quaternion converts as q_three = rotation(-90 degrees about x) * q_blender, because a camera looks down its own -z with +y up in both. (For ordinary objects the glTF exporter instead writes (w, x, z, -y), since their vertices are converted too.) The camera is also inside works-lane.glb as the node "main_camera" (and "side_camera", 2 m to the right).

set_notes.ground_height_formula: z = min(y, 26) * tan(0 deg) (channel line); pavement top = that + 0.13; road crown + 0.08
